name: Alex Moon
originStory: You were born to Sofia Moon and Thomas Moon, married eleven years by the time you arrived. She was a mechanic, he was a postal worker. There was always food on the table and never quite enough for the rest. No brothers, no sisters — the whole of their attention landed on you. Your mother Sofia never left the house without her face on, and taught you the same. In Amsterdam, in 2026. Nobody there had any idea what you would become.

timeline.text: Born in Amsterdam to Sofia Moon and Thomas Moon — a getting by household.

productions.title: Paper Cousin
productions.premise: A daughter who stayed away too long comes back to a terrace due for clearance. A will leaves everything to one of them, and it is too late to be fair about it.

scene.hint: Stand somewhere. They will say how far off you are.
scene.title: Paper Cousin
scene.line: Rosalind Varga has lit it and will not tell you where to stand. From in here you cannot see it at all.
